question: Where can I get a list of data center projects currently in permitting in the United States, with location, power (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: No national official list exists. Two Virginia counties publish open ArcGIS layers of data-center projects by stage: Loudoun County (319 parcel records; 177 proposed, snapshot 1 Sep 2026, edited 2026-11-16) and Prince William County (247 buildings: 68 Pending, 91 Planned, 28 Under Construction, 60 Completed). Both give location, stage and floor area but no MW, no applicant and no stage dates. A federal example, NNSA's Savannah River Site selection of Amentum (1 GW, 20 Jul 2026), shows the DOE route. ERCOT and Virginia DEQ pages were blocked; Cleanview's commercial API needs a key.
main_caveats: Loudoun and Prince William publish floor area (sq ft) and buildings, not MW; one 'In Legislative Process' parcel list holds 72 rows but only 20 distinct applications and 54 buildings.
Loudoun 'Owner' is the parcel owner from land records, populated for 2 of 177 proposed rows; it is not the applicant.
Stage dates are absent: Loudoun is a 1 Sep 2026 snapshot and PWC LastEditDate (last 2026-11-16) is a record edit date, not a permit event date.
Only the county zoning/building track is covered; no environmental permit or utility interconnection list was reached (Virginia DEQ and ERCOT returned HTTP 403 to automated requests).
DOE's 1 GW for Savannah River is a proposed lease at the selection stage; the basis (IT, facility or grid) is not defined.
Cleanview/commercial datasets give capacity_mw and developer, but need an API key and could not be tested.
answer.confidence_reason: Two county layers and one federal release were verified live, but they lack MW, applicant and dates; state and utility sources were blocked.

attributes.note: Loudoun parcel polygons with PIN; PWC building points with address. Federal release names only the site (Savannah River Site, SC).
attributes.gap_note: Only two counties and one federal site were verified; there is no national list of projects.

attributes.note: Only the DOE release gives power (1 GW data center, basis undefined). Loudoun and PWC publish square feet and building counts.
attributes.gap_note: County layers do not publish MW; IT vs facility vs grid basis is unknown. Commercial capacity_mw (Cleanview) was not tested.

attributes.note: DOE names Amentum for Savannah River; Loudoun 'Owner' is a parcel owner (2 of 177 proposed rows); PWC gives building names, not applicants.
attributes.gap_note: Applicant or developer is not a field in the county layers; names appear only in some building names or release text.

attributes.note: Loudoun: legislative / administrative / approved-no-permit / built; PWC BuildingStatus (Pending, Planned, Under Construction, Completed); DOE: selected to negotiate a lease.
attributes.gap_note: Stages are county land-use and building stages; environmental permits, utility interconnection and operation are not covered.

attributes.note: DOE release dated 2026-07-20 for its selection stage. Loudoun and PWC show snapshot or edit dates only.
attributes.gap_note: County layers carry no event dates for the stage; LastEditDate and layer dates do not document when a stage began.

open_questions: Pending: Virginia DEQ issued and pending air permits for data centers (HTTP 403 to automated access). Start: https://www.deq.virginia.gov/permits/public-notices/air from a browser.
Pending: ERCOT large-load reports and Texas jurisdictions (TCEQ air permits, county records). Start: ERCOT TAC 'Large Load Interconnection Status' deck.
Pending: obtain MW and applicant for Loudoun and Prince William cases via LandMARC and Energov by application number. Start: LEGI-2024-0004; REZ1958-0021.
Pending: other states (Arizona, Georgia, Ohio, Oregon) and DOE sites Idaho, Oak Ridge, Paducah; test Cleanview API if a key is provided by the user.
Pending: check Prince William Digital Gateway layer (PWDigital_Gateway) and the county's interactive map for event dates.
